The old classifier's gzip false-consistent bug is reproduced on both actual archives; the correction passes13 independent matching/missing/mismatch/incomplete controls. The independent stdlib parser reconciles collected/JUnit/journal/typed phases and OS exits. Full6076 outcomes/phases match the Author's one invocation; all5974 old IDs and102 new PASS IDs are retained. Fresh743 assertion-entry sets match for every node;16 earlier shared-wrapper refusals retain actual typed reason, phase and reached assertions. Downstream assertions remain unproved.

Author source5218/sdist5219 differ by15 added evidence files and one skill change. Runtime equality does **not** imply full-sdist equality; #142/#144 minimization is not claimed.

Unexecuted: live `tests/live/test_smoke.py::test_selected_repository`, benchmark `tests/e2e/test_github_sync.py::test_nested_pagination_stress_workload`, complete hosted release suite and I6-B/C/I7/I8 acceptance.
